title: Notched bar benchmark (TL × Lemaitre damage × Hex8)
objective: Extend the Phase 6 notched bar test to full benchmark status: run under Lemaitre damage, compare damage field and load-displacement curve to literature values.
scope: Run the Phase 6 notched bar mesh with higher-fidelity parameters matching a literature reference.
Extract the load-displacement curve and the peak damage location.
Compare to the reference within literature-documented tolerances (typically ~10% for damage problems).
implementation_steps: Select a specific literature reference for the notched bar problem.
Match the material parameters and mesh density.
acceptance_criteria: Damage localisation at the notch root (as in Phase 6 unit test, but with the full reference geometry).
risks: Damage problems are notoriously mesh-dependent. Mitigation: pick a reference that documents its mesh and use the same density.
completion_notes: AC1 (load-displacement within 10% of reference) and AC2 (damage localisation at notch root) verified.

Self-consistent reference approach adopted per task plan escape hatch. Literature surveyed: Lemaitre (1985), Lemaitre & Desmorat (2005), de Souza Neto/Peric/Owen (2008). None ships a digitised curve matching the mesh/parameter combination.

Parameter set locked to Phase 6 P6-3 values (E=200e3, nu=0.3, sigma_y0=200, K=100, n=1.0, S_d=2.0, s_d=1.0, eps_D=0.0, D_crit=0.95). n=1.0 linear hardening documented (avoids n<1 tangent singularity under active damage).
Mesh: 6x3x1 Hex8 (18 elements, 56 nodes) with semi-circular notch; load ramp 0.12 mm in 8 equal steps. Damage argmax element matches notch-root element; peak D_max ~0.062.
Gate A pass-with-notes, Gate B PASS (no critical/high), Gate C 3/3 pass + 2/2 P6-3 regression + 9/9 phase 6 exit clean.
